notes: Modified cash basis for governmental funds (fund balance = cash); business-type activities on the accrual basis. Beginning cash not printed (no prior-year balance sheet); ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet total assets (cash 5,429,547 + county treasurer cash 59,964, p4). Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position (p7, Total enterprise column): nonoperating grant income, insurance proceeds and the loss on disposal of assets (163,920, negative receipt) recorded as printed; net position 8,870,226 -> 8,786,069; no transfers. Internal Service Fund (governmental activities, health insurance) excluded. Proprietary cash flows from p8 (no noncapital financing section). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental and Business-type columns; component unit (CRA) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the Combining Statement of Revenues and Expenditures - General Fund Departments (pp13-14, more detailed than the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule p9, not recorded); Street and Debt Service from their budgetary comparison schedules (pp10-11; budget-only Debt Service 'Bond proceeds' line with no actual omitted; '-' budgets recorded as 0); nonmajor funds per fund from the combining statement (p12); no Water/Sewer detail (no utility budget schedule printed). 'Total operating expenses' subtotals on pp13-14 are not items. Grants lines have no grantor printed: category other, detail Grants. Department functions as in FY2023: General, Community Development, Planning = general government; Fire, Ambulance, Police = public safety; Cemetery = health/welfare; Airport = Airport (capital outlay without function); Recreation Center, Pool, Park, Library = culture/recreation.
